title: Native continuity — Prepare linked work after a known result-persistence failure, developed across fresh sessions
body:
## Goal and user authorization

The user approved this bounded development task and its native continuity observation on 2026-10-06 KST. Deliver one useful product extension: after a stateless model response has returned but committing its step result has failed, the user can review the retained evidence and prepare a separate linked work item through an ordinary authenticated product path. Preserve the failed attempt and create no execution authority.

Use this real development task to observe whether Augnes carries useful decisions, evidence, corrections and unresolved questions across three sequential Codex sessions: diagnosis, implementation, and verification. This is one task with two re-entry boundaries, not three independent samples or a comparative learning benchmark.

ChatGPT/Work owns scope, invariants and evidence review. Local Codex owns current-source diagnosis, implementation choices, verification and one Draft PR. The user is mobile-only; routine operation must not depend on their presence at the Mac.

Related owners: #1384 for bounded stateless work, #1215 for continuity evaluation. #1405/#1406 completed the separate Sol grant-lineage correction. #1407 completed this Mac's bounded adoption and saved-work journey; do not reopen its completed gates or close broader owners through this issue.

## Source basis and observed gap

Freshly checked main: `614d7407df97af9135976cef655653580964da67`; tree `92dfeb7a20d6df13aad5757e2dfc596766d7228b`. Recheck before execution; this is a planning baseline, not a reservation of main or a new verification receipt.

- `lib/vnext/runtime/stateless-source-review.ts` distinguishes `result_persistence_failed_no_retry` / `returned_unapplied` from host rejection and unknown dispatch.
- `scripts/test-stateless-source-review.ts:rejectionEvidenceContract` uses an isolated storage fault with scripted transport and explicitly expects no terminal preparation for this case.
- `lib/vnext/runtime/stateless-terminal-authorship.ts` and active 02 currently admit a narrower host-rejected returned-response case. Known persistence failure is intentionally outside that contract; merely removing its refusal would not define a correct replacement.
- Receipt-projection failure is a separate case: completed step rows can exist without a completed work receipt. It remains outside this extension.

These are source observations; Work did not run the Mac baseline in this commissioning step.

## User-visible outcome and allowed contract change

For the supported known result-persistence failure, expose a discoverable route from the saved failure review to review/compare selected material, preview, and explicitly author separate linked work. Reuse existing authentication, comparison, authorship, lineage and fresh-readback owners; Codex chooses the smallest coherent mechanism from current source.

The positive case must be backed by validated historical response/receipt and available evidence identifying result persistence as the failing layer, with an exact stopped attempt and no current writer or outstanding result publication. Do not infer this classification from a generic historical error, terminal status, or missing evidence. Examine the actual transaction and controller fences before choosing eligibility.

Required invariants:
- Preserve original run, steps, grants, receipts, usage/effect facts and failure history. Do not replay the model request, commit a missing old judgment, settle unknown provider effects, reset reconciliation, refund consumed allowance, or manufacture a successful RunReceipt.
- Create a distinct durable work/packet with `capability_grant: null`. No run, provider request, automation, accepted semantic state or restored execution permission follows.
- Keep mandatory operational failure lineage and inherited unresolved-effect obligations distinct from optional substantive notes. A returned answer is not automatically selected or promoted to accepted state. Unavailable public content stays unavailable.
- Bind historical invocation/grant/receipt/failure evidence to its immutable authority, preserving the #1406 correction. Current route configuration and elapsed historical expiry neither replace the grant nor authorize another call.
- Bind preview/save to current project, selection, root, task, selected material and exact predecessor history through the existing owners. Recheck atomically. Exact duplicate acknowledgement must not create another work; stale/conflicting or cross-project requests must not leave partial state.
- Preserve ordinary compatible readers, historical packets and recovery/read-only behavior. A new packet must be reconstructible after process re-entry.
- Known Gateway rejection/incomplete responses, unknown dispatch, unavailable or contradictory classification evidence, receipt-projection failure, recovery-suspended work and unrelated profiles gain no new eligibility. Their existing separate contracts remain intact.
- Preserve existing supported host-rejection, unknown-request disposition and completed-result paths. This issue does not qualify later execution of the newly authored family or general failure recovery.

If current source already provides the desired path, demonstrate it through its real owner and report no implementation needed. Do not invent a defect or force a new subsystem.

## Native development continuity scope

Use the already adopted local stack from #1407:
- Sole current development root/origin: `/Users/hynk/code/augnes` -> `https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes.git`.
- Approved native store: `/Users/hynk/Library/Application Support/Augnes/v1/checkouts/checkout-abde46b4408dd742/data/augnes.db`.
- Existing registered Augnes project, current Operator and checkout-bound Companion. #1407's client versions and readiness are historical observations to recheck, not permanent facts.

The user authorizes normal supported creation of this distinct development preparation and subsequent within-task revisions of goals/criteria/attributed progress notes, plus selected and bounded retained-note reads for this task. Preserve the prior acceptance work and all history; preparing a different task does not mark the prior preparation executed or semantically complete.

Prefer the installed Operator's existing new-work preview/prepare and revision preview/save tools when available and eligible. Resolve the current root through lifecycle/Resume, use exact fresh bindings, inspect each comparison, explicitly account for source selection/omissions, and re-read after save. Use ordinary Browser controls where required. An outcome-unknown save requires deliberate readback, never blind replay. Saved notes are attributed external Codex observations, not Augnes-managed execution receipts or accepted semantic facts.

Do not require the user to repeat a technical binding refresh or approve each already-authorized note update. Do not turn an observed refusal into a bypass. If capability, authentication, source/runtime compatibility or session creation is blocked, identify its actual governing instruction and available permitted mechanisms before asserting a physical Mac handoff is necessary.

Keep the qualified native service/data separate from candidate development verification. Recheck source/runtime bindings before every native observation. Do not silently restart, install or refresh production from unmerged candidate code, weaken identity checks, or substitute a disposable DB/source reconstruction for native re-entry. If development changes invalidate a supported native path, record the concrete conflict and use only a supported already-authorized separation; otherwise report that observation unavailable while completing independent development.

## Three sequential stages

Use one active checkout writer at a time, with the existing ownership protocol. Do not run competing development lanes.

1. **Diagnosis session.** Read current AGENTS.md, relevant active 01/02/03/04, current-continuity/Companion owners and Local Canonical policy. Confirm exact repository/branch/base/head, ownership, runtime/store and unrelated changes. Establish the new native preparation normally. Reproduce the present limitation through authenticated handlers and scripted transport in an isolated disposable store. Distinguish an existing test passing its intentional refusal assertion from the proposed product behavior being available. Save concise attributed findings: actual failing layer, evidence links, applicable conditions, chosen next action, alternatives rejected for a reason, and unresolved checks. Do not seed a deliberate mistaken belief just to create a correction.

2. **Fresh implementation session.** Bootstrap with only this unchanged commissioning issue, repository root, stage/authority and necessary saved-work locator. Do not forward the previous conversation, hidden thread history or a newly written narrative handoff. Read Augnes Resume and selected sources before the first substantive implementation decision. Record the selected next action and which retrieved material informed it, then use ordinary repository sources/tools. Implement the minimal extension. Revise the saved notes when actual evidence changes a conclusion; retain attribution, historical originals and still-valid conditions. If no correction is justified, say so rather than manufacture one.

3. **Fresh verification session.** Use the same bootstrap discipline. Read the saved development state and record the first proposed verification/review action. Inspect the actual diff and unresolved checks, perform necessary focused verification, correct concrete findings, and prepare one Draft PR with auto-merge disabled. Follow the current exact-base/head Local Canonical planner for the final clean candidate; preserve failed, interrupted and skipped evidence. Do not rerun an unchanged failed deciding head merely to get green. Save the resulting development status and remaining obligations through the normal native writer where supported.

A fresh session must be an actual newly created installed client/session, not a fork with inherited history, context compaction or a same-thread claim. Use documented local capabilities to perform the sequential handoffs autonomously where available; no routine human “next” is required. Do not assume a fresh model/session is blind to other available sources. Record actual exposure.

If creating a fresh session or reaching native continuity is genuinely unavailable, do not fake it or abandon independently authorized implementation. Preserve the checkpoint, record the precise capability/policy boundary, complete useful remaining development and mark the affected re-entry observation NOT RUN. Any fallback handoff/context repair counts in the burden record.

## Verification and observation

**Product correctness:** use disposable databases and scripted Gateway transport, with zero provider egress. Reuse existing fixtures and normal authenticated producers/consumers; an isolated fault hook may cause the failure but must not forge positive state or grants. Cover eligible first- and final-judgment result-persistence failures where the contract applies, Browser review/compare/preview/save, null-grant authorship, exact idempotency, fresh-process reconstruction, preserved historical rows and meaningful stale/scope/failure-class refusals. Cover mini/Sol historical grant compatibility through existing owners where affected. Test the actual path, not only a helper, and avoid redundant matrices.

**Continuity observation:** capture a small attributable record at each boundary:
- what the outgoing session saved and what the incoming session actually received;
- its first substantive chosen action and evidence used;
- valid conditions retained, genuinely resolved, explicitly superseded, or lost/unknown;
- justified rediscovery versus avoidable repetition or stale assumptions;
- every manual/coordinator context repair, note preparation/selection/save, fresh-session launch and other intervention;
- observed preparation, development, verification/repair and re-entry time/calls/tokens where available. Unobserved costs remain unknown.

Ordinary source inspection and safe verification are not automatically wasted repetition. Count the cost of producing and maintaining the Augnes notes, not only subsequent reads. Record external issue/PR/diff/log access and supplied answers; do not claim that retrieval caused a correct choice solely because it preceded it. Fault-injection cases are correctness evidence, not a usefulness comparison. Preserve P4.6's negative result and make no general autonomous-learning, comparative-cost or long-term-usefulness claim from this one task.

Do not expand this task into a general orchestrator, capability registry, cross-account/cloud trial, full-store migration, restore drill, new provider experiment, deployment or product release. Existing Codex development sessions are the execution harness; they do not establish an Augnes autonomous model–action loop.

## Deliverables and cleanup

Return one bounded Draft PR (or a source-backed no-change conclusion), exact source/environment identities, the actual commands/results and unrun checks, a concise three-stage continuity observation with its exposure/repair limits, and the remaining user-visible limitations. Update active documentation only for contracts/status/evaluation actually affected. Publish a concise nonsecret summary in the PR; preserve private/raw local verification evidence in its existing owners.

No merge, Ready transition, auto-merge, release, production installation/refresh/migration, arbitrary restore, deletion/pruning, hosted/legacy Apps rollout, paid provider experiment or accepted semantic-state change is authorized. Do not add fixture failures to the real native store. Preserve existing backups and historical evidence.

Clean candidate test resources, stop task-only keep-awake/processes, release checkout ownership, and leave the intentionally healthy qualified Companion and native work available when supported. Explain any final source/runtime mismatch truthfully. Keep this issue open for Work's post-implementation review.

## Work review checkpoint — 2026-10-06 KST

**Product extension: no additional blocking defect found in the reviewed source scope. Native three-stage development observation: partial, not qualified as a clean sequential handoff.** This issue remains open. PR #1409 remains Draft, unmerged, with auto-merge disabled; this review supplies no integration or adoption action.

### Reviewed identities and evidence

Fresh authenticated GitHub reads confirm main/base `614d7407df97af9135976cef655653580964da67`, PR head `f1febd217bb7a77b2e37b97cdc70f1adda6c89d2` and the reported six-file change. All six files were retrieved at that exact head and their Git blob identities match the PR file list.

Work reviewed the attached `closeout.json`, SHA-256 `aa7abf0d0d7e63e316c58a440ef39fd2ae047676380a3ec5596cd5dffcfc96e1`, alongside the current PR, implementation/tests/docs, unchanged failure-publication owner, checkout ownership owner and current Canonical policy. The report is not the raw Canonical receipt or raw client/approval log. Work did not rerun Mac tests, independently validate that local receipt, or inspect retained native rows.

The implementation adds strict available persistence-layer classification to the existing terminal-history reader, preserves immutable grant/receipt checks from #1406, checks absent committed result/completion evidence, and reuses atomic authenticated comparison/preview/authorship. The failed attempt and mandatory lineage remain historical; the new work has no execution grant. First/final mini/Sol handler cases, inherited uncertainty, refusal cases and fresh-process reconstruction are present in the source. The existing Browser test is exercised for the new case. The normal Canonical terminal-authorship entry now includes the persistence tests; this is not coverage available only behind an unused development flag.

The submitted phase data are internally consistent: 16 PASS phases, cleanup flags with zero owned processes, and the reported 5,823,791 ms interval. PR and closeout agree on receipt fingerprint `150a5b8bdb8b7de5e0016f81a14bece1f64fb5c48819d457f318d26d0d9a67b0` and validation on the candidate before main restoration. Those remain attributed local execution observations, not Work's independent runtime attestation. No new Canonical run is warranted merely for this review.

### Continuity outcome and permission clarification

The supplied timestamps independently yield 151 seconds of Stage 1/2 overlap: Stage 2 began at 10:45:13 KST while Stage 1 ended at 10:47:44 KST. Reported fresh-session calls sum to 31 and active durations to 24m53.744s. The three sessions read/saved native context, but their reproduction, implementation and deciding verification were not completed by those sessions. The coordinator's implementation and verification do not retrospectively complete their assigned stages.

The user now reports that they approved a subthread permission request after some delay. Preserve this as a user observation. The attached report does not include the matching request ID, approval timestamp or full decision-to-command trace, so this review cannot identify which request it was or attribute the overlap to the user's delay.

The report separately records a Stage 1 escalation that eventually returned `checkout_owner_busy`. Current ownership source distinguishes:
- `checkout_owner_process_unverifiable`: the requesting process's birth identity could not be verified before exclusive acquisition;
- `checkout_owner_busy`: the existing checkout owner's process identity is present and matches.

Tool approval is not checkout ownership. A later approval can remove an executor restriction while another live owner still prevents acquisition. The coordinator must await completion and owner release before the next execution stage; launching another stage while the earlier request remains unresolved does not establish a handoff. Do not weaken either boundary.

The coordinator's four `companion_unavailable` Resume results also remain an unexplained consumer-specific problem: Browser fallback and other fresh clients' successful reads do not establish that this consumer worked. They also do not prove that the entire installed Companion was unavailable.

### Bounded follow-up within this issue

Before attempting another continuity execution, reconcile the user's late approval against existing local request/decision/completion records, identify the actual owner at any busy result, and check whether any task-owned request remains pending or became executable after the final closeout observation. Do not repeat a denied operation merely to obtain its message. Respect the approval's exact scope; do not assume one approval changes every session profile.

Inspect the coordinator's actual Resume failure details against a working fresh client and the qualified main service, without exposing credentials or changing security settings. Use current documented capabilities and existing ownership/lifecycle owners. Record unknown causes as unknown. No forced process cleanup, lock deletion, candidate install or speculative product fix follows from the refusal summary.

Prepare a real sequential execution handoff: settle the outgoing invocation and consumers, release its exact owner, verify the incoming process is observable through its permitted executor, then acquire exclusive ownership before development. The coordinator must not retain an execution lease while asking the next session to acquire it. A pending approval keeps that execution stage pending; it is not permission to launch its successor.

Preserve this original partial observation permanently. Do not rerun full Canonical, repeat all completed product tests, invent a new implementation task, or relabel a later repaired setup as success of the original three-stage experiment. A subsequent meaningful continuation is a new observation with its own actual actors, exposure and repair burden.

## Follow-up disposition — 2026-10-06 KST

**The commissioned approval/ownership/Resume evidence follow-up is complete.** Preserve the original three-stage observation as partial. No further unchanged Canonical run, correctness-test repetition or speculative product change is required for this investigation.

Work reviewed the supplied `followup-review.json`, SHA-256 `3fc3d03325497d8aa56c190ad08c635ba075c462a2163190bf38e81febce6952`, checked its timing and prior-closeout hash consistency, and checked the relevant current proxy control flow. The underlying Mac audit database, rollout logs, process observations and native history were inspected by the executing lane; Work reviewed its attributed report rather than independently accessing those local artifacts.

Fresh GitHub reads still show main/base `614d7407df97af9135976cef655653580964da67` and unchanged PR #1409 head `f1febd217bb7a77b2e37b97cdc70f1adda6c89d2`, open Draft, unmerged and auto-merge disabled. The earlier bounded source-review conclusion is unchanged. Integration and candidate native adoption remain separate decisions; this issue stays open.

### Established findings from the reconciled local evidence

- The user's delayed approval matches Stage 1's exact ownership-holder command. It was requested at 10:36:20.223 KST and approved at 10:43:58.522201 KST, a 458.299201-second wait. The result was observed 2.709799 seconds after approval: `checkout_owner_busy`.
- The live incumbent was the coordinator's own development holder, acquired at 10:42:18.718 KST. Approval granted the exact command permission; it did not transfer the checkout. The persisted allowance covers that exact fixed command, not general Node/repository execution. The follow-up did not alter it or redispatch the operation.
- The coordinator's holder was recovered with retained evidence at 10:44:47.590 KST, before Stage 2 dispatch. Therefore Stage 2's refusal must **not** be attributed to that same occupied lease. Initial Stage 1 and sole Stage 2/3 attempts failed their own process-birth verification before exclusive acquisition. The precise underlying OS error was not retained; sandbox causation remains an inference, not an established OS denial.
- Stage 2 began at 10:45:13 KST while Stage 1 completed at 10:47:44 KST. The coordinator's dispatch reasoning still described an approval wait after the approval had already settled, and it had not observed Stage 1's final checkpoint/completion. This is a coordination/freshness error, not a failure caused solely by the user's approval delay.
- The follow-up found all three threads idle with terminal command results and no matching pending or later task execution. A persistent exact-command allow rule is not queued execution.

### Resume diagnosis and preserved uncertainty

The four parent failures share the post-discovery exception message. Current proxy source confirms this message is emitted by a catch after successful discovery; it does not identify the specific fetch, identity, size, JSON/schema or projection exception. Fresh clients' successes and healthy current service observations cannot qualify the failed parent consumer.

The report identifies a pre-refresh long-lived proxy with a retired cache working directory, while fresh clients use the current matching cache. This supports a stale-consumer hypothesis. Exact thrown exceptions, loaded-code identity and direct PID-to-coordinator mapping remain unproven. Do not label the hypothesis a confirmed parse defect, authentication failure or whole-service outage. Existing historical diagnostics cannot reconstruct an exception they did not retain.

### Native correction and next boundary

The executing lane reports saving the new attributed correction through normal Browser comparison/save and exact reload readback. Seven other selected note bodies were unchanged; the superseded original was read intact through retained history. No managed receipt or accepted semantic fact was created. Source/PR, service installation and permissions were unchanged; no tests, Canonical, migration, service restart or new development session ran. The healthy intended service was preserved, ownership was absent and the temporary task lease was stopped at the recorded closeout.

For a later meaningful continuation, use an actual freshly loaded compatible client and establish permitted process observability before admitting development. Settle outgoing commands, approvals and consumers, save/read back the checkpoint, release the exact owner, and only then admit the next exclusive writer. The coordinator must hold no competing execution lease; unresolved approval or command completion keeps that stage pending.

The present result remains: bounded product extension qualified for an integration decision based on the reviewed source and attributed exact-head local evidence; native note transfer/correction observed; clean sequential development and comparative usefulness not established. A later corrected observation must remain a new observation, not a relabeling of this one.


## Integration disposition — 2026-10-06 KST

**PR #1409 was merged by the user. This bounded implementation, evidence review and follow-up are complete; close #1408 with the continuity observation still classified as partial.** Earlier Draft/open statements above are historical checkpoints.

Fresh authenticated GitHub reads establish:
- User merge time: 2026-10-06 14:37:23 KST.
- Merged commit and current main: `6132a37ceb34799ad65c6233e58ed6405abf2a01`.
- First parent: reviewed base `614d7407df97af9135976cef655653580964da67`.
- Second parent: reviewed PR head `f1febd217bb7a77b2e37b97cdc70f1adda6c89d2`.
- Merged tree: `18a300c3d9617b7de82b634a2e609f2222dee229`, identical to the reviewed candidate tree.

This ordinary merge preserves the reviewed ancestry and source content. The existing Local Canonical evidence remains evidence for its exact candidate/source/environment pair; no new deciding run or independent Mac runtime verification was performed for this disposition.

The delivered product extension supports preparing distinct linked work after precisely evidenced result-persistence failure through the existing authenticated authorship path, with a null execution grant and preserved predecessor history/effects. It does not establish general failure recovery or later execution of that work.

The native observation is not promoted to successful sequential development: three fresh sessions read/saved context, but the coordinator completed development and verification, Stage 1/2 overlapped, and incoming ownership capability was not established. The reconciled approval, coordination error, saved correction, historical evidence and unresolved Resume exception remain as recorded above. Broader continuity/usefulness evaluation remains with #1215; broader stateless-work obligations remain with #1384. This closure neither closes those owners nor establishes comparative or autonomous-learning benefit.

Repository integration does not establish installation/adoption of this commit. The last attributed healthy native observation used `614d7407df97af9135976cef655653580964da67`; current Mac checkout, installed service/build and client bindings have not been re-observed here. No native refresh, installation, migration, restart, provider call, fixture injection into retained data or deployment follows from this disposition. Any later meaningful continuation must check those actual bindings and use a fresh compatible client with the corrected sequential ownership handoff. Preserve this experiment's partial result rather than relabeling it.
